body.description: Plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

get.description: Liveness and database check for uptime monitoring. Reveals nothing else.

post.description: Sign in with email and password. Sets the session cookies. If the password was a temporary one, the answer is a `passwordChange` step instead (no session, no cookies) and the person must choose a new password first.

200.description: Signed in (a session, with the cookies set), or the password was right and a second step is needed (a challenge, no session)

401.description: Wrong email or password. The same answer for an unknown email.

post.description: The second step of sign-in: the six-digit code from the authenticator app (or a recovery code) plus the challenge from sign-in. Sets the session cookies.

401.description: `invalid_code` (wrong, already used or expired) or `invalid_challenge` (start again from the password)

post.description: Starts setting up the authenticator app: returns a new secret (to type in or scan) and the address an app can open. Asking again replaces an unconfirmed secret.

200.description: The secret to add to the app

401.description: The challenge is missing, expired or for another step

409.description: Already turned on

post.description: Confirms the first code from the app, turns two-step sign-in on, signs the person in (cookies set) and returns ten single-use recovery codes, shown this once.

409.description: `no_setup`: no secret was started, or it is already on

post.description: Swaps the refresh cookie for a new pair of cookies.

401.description: No valid session. `refresh_in_progress` means retry once.

post.description: Ends the session and clears the cookies. Always succeeds.
Asks for a password-reset email. The answer is always 202, whether or not the address has an account, so it cannot be used to find out who is registered. Limited per account and per address.

202.description: If the address has an account, an email is on its way

post.description: Sets a new password with the token from the emailed link. The token works once. Ends every session the account had.

400.description: The link is wrong, already used or expired (the same answer for all three)

422.description: The new password is not acceptable; the link still works

get.description: Who is signed in, from the signed access cookie. No database read.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access cookie expired

post.description: Choose a password of your own after signing in with a temporary one. Needs the challenge that sign-in returned (not a session, and it works once). Then carries on as sign-in does: an authenticator step, or the session with its cookies.

200.description: Signed in (a session, with the cookies set), or the person still has an authenticator step to do (a challenge, no session)

401.description: `invalid_challenge`: expired, already used, not for this step, or the person is switched off. Sign in again.

422.description: The password breaks a rule (`weak_password`, saying which) or is the temporary one (`same_password`); nothing changed

post.description: Change your own password (Settings, D-091). Needs the current one; a wrong one counts toward the sign-in lockout. Every other session ends; this one carries on.

422.description: `wrong_password` (the current one is not right), `weak_password` (saying which rule), or `same_password`; nothing changed

429.description: Too many wrong passwords for this email in the last 15 minutes; nothing changed

404.description: No such person
